en: where are you from?
Even the shop folk say they've never seen
a gentleman as fine as you.
So I simply had to ask.
I'm sorry... but I cannot answer that.
Oh, listen to me... I'm terribly sorry.
I asked something I had no business asking.
Are you looking for something?
I'm looking for pen and ink.
This shop certainly has a lot of wares.
Why, our selection is our pride and joy.
I'll bring them right out. Just a moment!
Will these do? Both are of good quality
and will last you a long time.
Then I'll take these.
Please do come again.
Oh, how nice of you to come by.
This shop certainly has a lot of wares.
Certainly. One moment, please.
How about these? Both are of good quality
Are you looking for something again?
Have you taken a liking to our shop?
<Yes>
<Not really...>
I'm so glad to hear you say that.
We carry a few imported goods, too.
Please do keep coming to our shop.
Oh... what a pity.
I'm so glad you've been coming often lately.
Yes, this shop is handy for all sorts of things.
And you've been a great help too. I'm grateful.
Oh, you're too kind... Thank you so much.
If there's ever anything I can do for you,
anything at all, please just ask.
(Anything, she says
One day, it will come to that.)
Um...
Would you listen to me?
I have a little dream.
Someday, I want a shop of my own
That's all.
Oh dear, how silly of me.
Why am I telling you all this?
But somehow,
, talking with you
puts me at ease.
I see. I hope your dream comes true.
(How foolish...
when your fate is already sealed.)
Seeing you somehow lifts my spirits.
It reminds me of my own dream.
I'm Angela. The back of the house
makes me so very happy.
Do come by the shop again, too.
Sorry, I'd rather not talk about that.
I ran away from home, you see...
I'm sorry, I shouldn't have pried...
Forgive me if I offended you.
No, it's fine. Don't worry about it.
I'm looking for pen and ink.
There's so much here, I can't find them.
I'll bring them right out. One moment, please.
Then I'll take these.
Not at all, it's my job.
Thank you. Please come again.
Welcome! Are you looking for something?
Oh! You're...
I'm looking for pen and ink, but...
How about these? They're fine goods.
Oh, I'm glad I could help.
Do come again!
Welcome! Please keep coming back to us.
<Of course>
Yes, I'm very fond of this shop.
And I look forward to seeing you, Angela.
Someday, I want to have a shop of my own.
Somehow,
talking with you puts me at ease.
That's a lovely dream. I hope it comes true.
